utsw-hsa-temozolomide-propranolol.identity: Exact AVMA VCT25005913/22252; randomized doxorubicin or carboplatin with temozolomide and propranolol. Distinct from Fort Worth VCT26005971.
utsw-hsa-temozolomide-propranolol.recruitment_sites: Dallas UT Southwestern VROC, exact card active signup and native Recruiting; one Dallas location.
utsw-hsa-temozolomide-propranolol.eligibility: Biopsy confirmed HSA (splenic, liver, heart, intramuscular), survival >2 weeks, no major organ failure; no both prior doxorubicin and carboplatin, one previous allowed for alternate arm, antioxidant supplements must stop.
utsw-hsa-temozolomide-propranolol.funding: Native exact Unfunded; no price or subsidy displayed.
utsw-hsa-temozolomide-propranolol.deadline: Exact rendered recruitment period 2025-01-06 through 2028-01-08 Dallas. This confirms previously retained date directly.

ca-ovc-osa-hifu.identity: MRI-guided HIFU ablation for distal-radius OSA, Brigitte Brisson pilot.
ca-ovc-osa-hifu.recruitment_sites: Current OVC canine roster and individual protocol; at least one SickKids Toronto treatment/imaging visit plus several OVC Guelph visits.
ca-ovc-osa-hifu.eligibility: Confirmed distal radius canine OSA, no metastases, no prior surgery or radiotherapy for OSA; previous chemo and bisphosphonates case-by-case.
ca-ovc-osa-hifu.funding: MRI, HIFU, associated anesthesia, study biopsy and analysis covered. Other charges not specified.
ca-ovc-osa-hifu.contacts: OVC Clinical Trials and official study contact path.
ca-ovc-osa-hifu.deadline: No end date in primary; study visits are not a cutoff.

ca-ovc-oral-melanoma-palladia.identity: Toceranib phosphate (Palladia) for canine oral melanoma, Anthony Mutsaers/Gabby Allegrini.
ca-ovc-oral-melanoma-palladia.recruitment_sites: Current canine study roster and individual case protocol; multiple Guelph visits.
ca-ovc-oral-melanoma-palladia.eligibility: Biopsy-proven oral melanoma, measurable disease, no prior chemotherapy; previous melanoma vaccine permitted.
ca-ovc-oral-melanoma-palladia.funding: Initial staging bloodwork/chest x-rays/biopsy, Palladia and associated fees covered; other costs not stated.
ca-ovc-oral-melanoma-palladia.contacts: OVC Clinical Trials and official study contact path.

be-ghent-feline-mammary-gcn2-inhibitor.identity: GCN2-IN-6 orally pre/post standard mastectomy, Ada Krupa/Hilde de Rooster.
be-ghent-feline-mammary-gcn2-inhibitor.recruitment_sites: Ghent current Onderzoek roster, independent veterinarian and owner protocol sections; one Veterinary Teaching Hospital Merelbeke-Melle.
be-ghent-feline-mammary-gcn2-inhibitor.eligibility: Cat with diagnosed mammary tumor and eligible for surgery; unknown histopathology/fitness require investigator.
be-ghent-feline-mammary-gcn2-inhibitor.funding: Study drug supplied without additional cost; staging, surgery and other costs not explicitly covered.
be-ghent-feline-mammary-gcn2-inhibitor.deadline: No published recruitment or study end date.

jp-nihon-proteasome-inhibitor-b-cell-tum.identity: Human-oncology proteasome inhibitor, drug name not explicitly identified; bortezomib case is background.
jp-nihon-proteasome-inhibitor-b-cell-tum.recruitment_sites: Current Nihon Fujisawa index and named case-specific protocol.
jp-nihon-proteasome-inhibitor-b-cell-tum.eligibility: Dog or cat with confirmed B-cell lymphoid tumor (lymphoma, plasma cell or selected B-cell CLL). Prior therapy stable for one week; ability to maintain daily activities and attend visits.
jp-nihon-proteasome-inhibitor-b-cell-tum.funding: Current primary does not disclose treatment/screening or monitoring costs.
jp-nihon-proteasome-inhibitor-b-cell-tum.contacts: Nihon University Animal Medical Center oncology Dr Tani.
jp-nihon-proteasome-inhibitor-b-cell-tum.deadline: No recruitment end; protocol original and modified dates are publication metadata.

jp-nihon-mutation-positive-lung-cancer.identity: Unspecified oral molecular targeted agent for mutation-positive canine lung cancer, three weekly assessments.
jp-nihon-mutation-positive-lung-cancer.recruitment_sites: Current NIH Nihon index and exact protocol; Fujisawa animal center.
jp-nihon-mutation-positive-lung-cancer.eligibility: Dog ≥4kg with a lesion and qualifying mutation tested at Nihon, unsuitable for surgery or declined; no post-surgery cases with no remaining lesion.
jp-nihon-mutation-positive-lung-cancer.funding: Costs not stated by the official protocol.
jp-nihon-mutation-positive-lung-cancer.contacts: Nihon University Animal Medical Center oncology Dr Tani.
jp-nihon-mutation-positive-lung-cancer.deadline: No published cutoff; three weeks is treatment duration.

jp-nihon-head-neck-alternating-magnetic-.identity: Nonthermal alternating magnetic field delivered in six 30-minute sessions under anesthesia.
jp-nihon-head-neck-alternating-magnetic-.recruitment_sites: Current NIH Nihon recruiting index and exact individual protocol; Fujisawa.
jp-nihon-head-neck-alternating-magnetic-.eligibility: Small to medium dogs with malignant head, oral or neck tumor; examples include oral melanoma, nasal and brain tumor; fit and anesthesia suitability need team confirmation.
jp-nihon-head-neck-alternating-magnetic-.funding: Study treatment and related tests free, no participation payment.
jp-nihon-head-neck-alternating-magnetic-.contacts: Nihon University radiation oncology Dr Tomohiro Nakayama.
jp-nihon-head-neck-alternating-magnetic-.deadline: JST grant 2021–2028 not a published exact enrollment end; no dated recruitment cutoff.

jp-nihon-canine-glioma-il12.identity: IV collagen-binding-domain linked IL-12 in two doses; MRI every 3 months through 18 months.
jp-nihon-canine-glioma-il12.recruitment_sites: Current NIH Nihon recruiting index and exact individual protocol; Fujisawa.
jp-nihon-canine-glioma-il12.eligibility: Canine initial MRI or histopathologic glioma and recurrence after surgery/RT. Flow diagram references biopsy for initial pathway; no expansion without team screening. Poor-prognosis unrelated disease exclusion.
jp-nihon-canine-glioma-il12.funding: Primary says ask about details and costs; no published subsidy.
jp-nihon-canine-glioma-il12.deadline: No published cutoff. 18 months refers to follow-up.
